basis.statement: Atlas currently represents source-supported relations and load-bearing work, but the distinction between generic relation, dependence, load, and consequence is not yet intervention-grounded.

desired_consequence.statement: One bounded matched-pair specimen distinguishes a merely source-supported relation from a candidate reconstruction dependence by an observed difference on the declared SEMANTIC_RECONSTRUCTION measure under a controlled evidence-aperture perturbation.

current_obstruction.statement: Without perturbation evidence, Atlas cannot know whether a relation actually bears continuity load or is only correlated/redundant support, weakening decomposition and horizon relevance.

relevance_test.question: Would distinguishing relation from load-bearing dependence change how Atlas selects, compresses, reconstructs, or repairs work?

pressure_selection.selection_basis: A workcycle evidence edge should not acquire dependence standing merely because it exists; dependence requires observed continuity difference under a bounded perturbation.

expected_information_gain.statement: Whether withholding one exact related evidence object changes the declared semantic-reconstruction measure for the same addressed workcycle subject under the same observable inference contract.

pressure_selection.application_dependency: If the matched-pair observation strengthens a bounded reconstruction-dependence candidate, Atlas may represent dependency standing as subject + dependency target + declared load dimension + evidence aperture + scope + temporal coordinate + standing, while retaining the generic relation separately.

success_condition.statement: Matched fresh reconstruction runs differ only in the declared evidence aperture across all required observable coordinates, and an independent evaluator can classify one observed matched-pair difference on the declared SEMANTIC_RECONSTRUCTION measure.

failure_condition.statement: Required observable inference coordinates differ, or the runs cannot support a bounded comparison of the declared semantic-reconstruction measure.

unresolved_condition.statement: The single matched pair is insufficient to distinguish redundancy, candidate reconstruction dependence, confounding, or residual inference variance.

unresolved_load_bearing_questions: Does the candidate evidence relation affect the declared SEMANTIC_RECONSTRUCTION measure for this exact subject, aperture, scope, source ref, and matched observable inference regime?
Orthogonal load dimensions are not evaluated.
Reproducibility is not established by one A/B pair.

proposed_change.statement: Represent any supported candidate reconstruction dependence as subject + dependency target + declared load dimension + evidence aperture + scope + temporal coordinate + standing, while retaining the underlying generic relation separately.

application.withholding_basis: Requires one clean matched-pair observation and independent adjudication; reproducibility and orthogonal load exclusion remain unearned.

consequence_observation.expected_effect: Future Atlas decomposition can distinguish generic relation existence from bounded evidence-aperture reconstruction dependence without claiming whole-system existential dependence.

basis_reconciliation.remaining_gap: No bounded intervention evidence yet distinguishes relation from dependence.

if_this_work_succeeds.what_changes_in_the_operating_world: Atlas gains an evidence-based rule for whether a relation should influence reconstruction/decomposition as a load-bearing dependency, reducing arbitrary task relevance and false topology weight.
